messages:
Alex Kim: UX bug: empty state on the Dedicated pools page says "No pools configured" which sounds like an error. Users thought their reserved capacity disappeared.
Riley Gomez: Yeah that's alarming. We should soften it and give next steps: how to create a pool or check billing.
Harper Nguyen: Also add a subtle explanation about what 'Dedicated pools' are for new users. The current copy assumes infra knowledge.
Alex Kim: Proposed copy: Title: "No dedicated capacity yet" Body: "You don't have any reserved GPU pools. Create a dedicated pool to run larger workloads with predictable throughput and isolation." Primary CTA: "Create dedicated pool" Secondary: "Learn how dedicated pools work"
Riley Gomez: Love the tone. Suggest adding a short line about billing: "Reserved pools require a monthly commitment; see pricing details." Maybe as inline subtext not to scare first-time users.
Harper Nguyen: Accessibility: make the CTAs keyboard-focusable and ensure the secondary link includes context (not just 'Learn more'). Also include aria-describedby pointing to the pricing sentence.
design-bot: Accessibility lint: avoid starting sentences with the word 'Note:' in screen-reader content; ensure focus order leads to primary CTA first. Use descriptive link text.
Alex Kim: Localization keys: `empty.dedicated.title`, `.body`, `.cta_create`, `.link_learn`. Final copy for translations file: `No dedicated capacity yet`; `You don't have any reserved GPU pools. Create a dedicated pool to run larger workloads with predictable throughput and isolation.`; CTA `Create dedicated pool`; Link `Learn how dedicated pools work`; Inline subtext: `Reserved pools require a monthly commitment. See pricing details.`
Riley Gomez: I'll PR this small copy change and add a hover tooltip on the pricing text that includes billing link; tooltip will be accessible via keyboard and have aria-label "Pricing details for dedicated pools".
Harper Nguyen: LG from content. Nice and friendly tone.
Alex Kim: Thanks! :seedling:
